title: Round-3 no-oracle doc comment overclaims: ok:false also fires on the upsert-abort arm, not "only when the Resend call itself failed"
detail: The comment rewritten in this round's sent-flag-removal hunk states ok:false occurs "only when the Resend call itself failed", but a failed draft upsert also aborts before the claim with ok:false 200 (by design — "a stale-state link is worse than no link"). Behaviour is correct; the contract comment misdescribes it.
recommended_fix: Amend the comment to "ok:false only when the save-half upsert failed or the Resend call itself failed" (same for the spec change-log line "ok:false only on Resend failure").
